record.paper_title: Kinetic plasma turbulence: recent insights and open questions from 3D3V simulations
record.original_question: How does free energy cascade through phase space in kinetic plasma turbulence when multiple collisionless processes are active at ion and electron scales? A satisfactory answer must explain how turbulent energy is transferred across both spatial and velocity-space structure in weakly collisional magnetized plasmas.

evidence.quote: several collisionless plasma processes may be simultaneously at play and compete with each other in determining the nature of ion-scale and electron-scale fluctuations ... and, consequently, how free energy cascades in phase space

artifact.status_search_result: The phase-space free-energy cascade in kinetic plasma turbulence remains an active area of research. While significant progress has been made—including the entropy/phase-space cascade theory of Schekochihin et al., the "fluidization" mechanism by which nonlinear advection can suppress linear phase mixing (Schekochihin–Parker–Highcock 2016), and recent work on phase-space entropy cascade and irreversibility of stochastic heating (2024)—a unified quantitative theory accounting for the simultaneous competition of multiple collisionless channels at ion and electron scales has not been established. Recent literature continues to describe velocity-space cascade studies as being in their infancy and explicitly identifies this as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Phase-space entropy cascade and irreversibility of stochastic heating in nearly collisionless plasma turbulence
status_evidence.snippet: Entropy cascade as a nonlinear phase-mixing process whereby collisionless damping is made irreversible; recent (2024) advances but still active.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2024) work shows the topic remains under active investigation rather than settled.

status_evidence.title: Fluidization of collisionless plasma turbulence
status_evidence.snippet: Nonlinear advection can suppress linear phase mixing; conditions for genuine velocity-space cascade vs fluidization remain to be characterized in full kinetic regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial theoretical results exist but a unified picture is open.

status_evidence.title: Evidence of entropy cascade in collisionless magnetized plasma turbulence
status_evidence.snippet: Observational/numerical evidence of entropy cascade; quantitative partition among competing channels not fully resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Empirical support exists for cascade picture but quantitative theory of competing channels is incomplete.

status_evidence.title: Kinetic Plasma Turbulence: Recent Insights and Open Questions From 3D3V Simulations
status_evidence.snippet: Several collisionless plasma processes may simultaneously compete in determining ion- and electron-scale fluctuations and how free energy cascades in phase space.
status_evidence.claim: Identified explicitly as an open question.
